authorityRead.policyX: Current exact source is permitted only before Draft. Candidate changes only PREPARE applicability and its real PREPARE capacity acceptance; existing frozen instruction/quote/capacity/owner proofs remain. No post-Draft live economic fallback.

diagnosis.witnessStatus: Original callback true/false reproduced; genuine complete WORKERS page exactly 1, matching candidate REVIEW / CASE_WEEK_BASIS_UNBOUND. Seven vector windows reached, not the complete 12-vector financial matrix.
genuineInputChain: Two actual original payments are created through parsed Final/APP/source/pay run/payment completion owners; originals are preserved immutable point links.
Original payments and recovery pay run all use pay_date 2026-10-09, same ISO Monday week 2026-10-05. Source/work weeks are earlier; pay-date week, not work week, controls this binding.
0420 no-case week fact publisher returns for target channel other than PAYE; prior genuine no-case Umbrella originals therefore have no worker_week_contribution.
0430 original no-case Umbrella outcome is likewise not an eligible maintained prior fact. Joined widening is case-only and does not retrofit no-case originals.
Effective joined PREPARE currently demands a contribution for every earlier READY/DRAFT/ISSUED/COMPLETE same-candidate worker in this pay-date week, before instruction capture/origin/valuation.
0290 explicitly applies H/floor/threshold protection only to LOAN/ADVANCE/MANUAL_DEBT; OVERPAYMENT gross recovery uses exact nominal, usable capacity and channel headroom without H/floor money.
0390 NET already expresses NOT_AFFECTED when no allocated protected NET debt needs the week basis; it still requires the current week metadata relation.
diagnosis.missingAuthority: Maintained eligible prior take-home contributions for the exact earlier Umbrella run workers. Not a missing CASE origin, work_collection, quote, policy window, or current channel configuration.
diagnosis.classification: Independently confirmed narrow product applicability defect. Same-week genuine channel change is not made harmless by editing the fixture date, expected recovery money, paid originals, or injecting prior contributions. Missing weekly authority remains a real blocker for every selected protected or other unsupported instruction set.
diagnosis.precisionLimit: The V3 receipt captures the issue code, not the exact SQL branch. Source traces independently explain the missing prior-Umbrella metadata path; root successor probe records actual prior counts/current-week unresolved count to distinguish it from the other same-code branch.

proposal.eligibility: Nonempty exact SEALED selected set; selected count equals actual selected identities; case/component both OVERPAYMENT, instruction RECOVERY, stage GROSS_DEDUCT. Every other set preserves the original UNBOUND/WEEK_CAPTURE path.
proposal.frozenReproof: Every captured instruction must retain class. Before allocation, exact frozen count, captured/header/worker counts, sealed header and selected identity membership are checked. CASE_RESERVE accepts NOT_AFFECTED only with its own exact frozen count/class/membership proof plus every inherited real PREPARE, source tuple, hold, capacity, module/candidate owner and operation proof.
proposal.currentWeek: Existing genuine current week row creation/lock/floor revision capture remains exactly unchanged for NET and current worker lifecycle. It is not a fabricated prior contribution.
proposal.scalarCarry: NOT_AFFECTED does not claim BOUND weekly take-home. The existing initial carry uses the exact captured current gross, as before; no earlier money is guessed. For this proved class H is not an affordability operand. Remaining carry is not evidence of the missing prior week's take-home.
unchanged: all 12 original financial vectors and order
active capacity reservations and actual completion
all existing WEEK_CAPTURE and return-floor checks
proposal.performanceNote: New scalar count/class membership proofs are indexed to the exact selected run/candidate/revision or frozen run worker/revisions; no prior-money SUM, all-candidate scan or serialization is introduced. Their scan cost is not claimed as a performance acceptance.

focusedControls.hookNativeControls: Exact two existing prosrc MD5 pre/post and retained posture; 11 read-only class/count/absence/mixed predicate scenarios; unchanged original allocator floor control for all three protected kinds.
focusedControls.controlLimit: Predicate VALUES are not financial rows. Kernel calls validate unchanged protected floor semantics only. These controls do not claim genuine protected PREPARE journey proof.
focusedControls.rootMatrix: Root-only existing rolled-back host, original unchanged all12 matrix/callback/expected money. Install candidate only after distinct Extra High review. Observe actual downstream REVIEW without altering the reply.
focusedControls.requiredObservedPositive: For UMBRELLA_PAYE_-30: actual prior Umbrella missing contribution count remains >0; no fake prior facts; exactly one current week row; truthful NOT_AFFECTED, complete exact frozen overpayment selection; original REVIEW/all recovery/payment assertions must pass unchanged.
furtherGenuineNegativeControlsRequiredBe: Through existing CASE_CREATE/queue/selection owners, select each LOAN/ADVANCE/MANUAL_DEBT with genuine same-week missing prior Umbrella metadata: must retain CASE_WEEK_BASIS_UNBOUND and no recovery hold.
Through the same owners, mixed selected overpayment plus protected recovery must stay week-dependent. Excluded protected rows must not be promoted to selected eligibility.
Missing/contradictory sealed selection or frozen capture counts/identities must be refused, never treated as NOT_AFFECTED.
A fully bound protected debt retains genuine floor/threshold amount/replay semantics; returned/reissued unresolved prior facts retain original refusal.
focusedControls.freshRollback: Require the existing full fresh preservation capture, distinguish expected global/sequence gaps from any real row/catalogue change, retain all old failed receipts. Inverse is complete preimage source, not permission to install durably.
